name: 84604 · Provo, UT
findings: ZIP 84604 (Provo) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84604 (Provo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84604 (Provo) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: No religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 31 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
